headline: Portfolio Outperformance vs. SPY YTD
summary: As of October 15, 2026, the portfolio set is outperforming SPY with an average return of 26.23% compared to SPY's 13.71%. This 12.52% average alpha indicates that the portfolios are not only gaining in absolute terms but are also exceeding the benchmark's performance. The top portfolio, 'Random A', has achieved a remarkable return of 42.31%, significantly contributing to the overall outperformance. In contrast, the weakest portfolio, 'Random B', has a return of just 3.53%, highlighting a disparity in performance among the portfolios. This outperformance against SPY is particularly relevant during periods of macro uncertainty, as it suggests resilience in the portfolio's strategy. Note: Updated 30 minutes before and after market close.
